spot_body: Open Spot and take a photo of a car you see, or choose one from your photos. Auto-fill can fill in the car, the city and the paint for you.
blur_body: Redline blurs licence plates on your phone before anything is uploaded. You check every plate yourself, and plate text is never stored.
collect_body: Every new car becomes a sticker on its album page. Complete pages and sets, and earn XP with the weekly challenges.
